title: Cinema Sound Calibration — Cinema Sound System Maintenance Calibration
scope: This document details a set of recommended practices for the maintenance calibration and documentation of sound systems in dubbing stages (mixing rooms), screening rooms, and commercial cinemas to determine, and hopefully verify, the consistency of reproduction of motion picture sound in these spaces over time — in other words to provide a means to maintain correct calibration of a given space in the future.
